quests.title: Organic Synthesis Master
quests.description: Master organic chemistry reactions and synthesis pathways!

story.introduction: The Pharmaceutical Research Lab needs your expertise in organic synthesis to develop new medicines!

steps.title: Reaction Mechanism Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Synthesis challenges you to predict the products of organic reactions.

problem.question: What is the major product when 2-methylpropene reacts with HBr?
problem.explanation: According to Markovnikov's rule, H⁺ adds to the carbon with more hydrogens, and Br⁻ adds to the carbon with fewer hydrogens, forming the more stable tertiary carbocation.
